notes.title: Mad Dojo Update Version 2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27831186/746ee11f6c8ce939cad9e885200d2905ebc5918a.png

Mad Dojo Update: Version 2.0 is Here!

We're excited to introduce Mad Dojo Version 2.0, featuring three key updates:


 Improved Player Physics: Enjoy better jump control and enhanced aerial manoeuvrability, making you feel like a true martial arts master.

 Procedurally Generated Practice Levels: Train endlessly in unique levels that never repeat, offering infinite challenges to test your skills.

 Sleek UI: Experience a revamped user interface for easy navigation and a more visually appealing game.



Update now and embrace the next level of martial arts action in Mad Dojo!

Update v0.03
notes.content:
Key updates:

Procedural generation of levels.
Keyboard support.
Camera follow – Camera pans to the direction player goes. Also, while not jumping, player can pan camera up or down a bit with up/down keys.
Level finish animation updated.
New trap in levels – Acid ball.
Death echo – marker which shows where the player died in the level.
UI – Player can now access How to play screen from the Options menu.
New achievement – Pioneer of randomness – for finishing the first randomly generated level.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=agnPSHghdIQ&feature=youtu.be
